data.title: Malte Amundsen scores 2 goals, Crew beats Toronto 4-2 for 5th win in last 6 games - The Washington Post
data.content: # Malte Amundsen scores 2 goals, Crew beats Toronto 4-2 for 5th win in last 6 games. COLUMBUS, Ohio — Malte Amundsen scored two goals, his first career multi-goal game in MLS, Gonzalo Tapia and Brooks Lennon each added a goal, and the Columbus Crew beat Toronto FC 4-2 on Saturday. Columbus Crew players celebrate their goal against Toronto FC during the first half of an MLS soccer match, Saturday, Oct. 24, 2026, in Columbus, Ohio. Malte Amundsen scored two goals, his first career multi-goal game in MLS, Gonzalo Tapia and Brooks Lennon each added a goal, and the Columbus Crew beat Toronto FC 4-2.
